Chief Keef’s son is making his family proud in the classroom! 🙏📚 His mom shared that he has a 4.0 GPA, giving everyone a reason to celebrate his academic success 💯👏

Maintaining a GPA like that takes effort and consistency, so this is an accomplishment that deserves some recognition. With so much attention usually focused on artists and their careers, it’s nice to see a proud parent sharing a positive moment about their child’s education ❤️

Chief Keef has given fans plenty of memorable moments through his music, but this celebration belongs to his son and the work he’s putting into school. Hopefully, there are plenty more achievements ahead for him as he continues his education 🙌
